title: Measure the original Avro fast reader opening claims on bound JARs
description: The historical test already fails twice on the parent and passes twice on the fix. Skip the isolated Maven invoker's unrelated compatibility build, which tried to resolve a plugin outside the mirror. Package the original core and check fast binary decoding on both revisions.
expected: Both named regressions qualify, four finite results match their frozen outcomes, and every ordinary claim has an opening verifier receipt.

steps.name: Package unchanged Avro core and run both upstream parameters
steps.run: export TMPDIR="${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/in-the-loop/tmp"; repos=(); if test -d "${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/in-the-loop/external-upgrades/ci-sources/java-domain-proof/avro"; then repos=(--repos "${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/in-the-loop/external-upgrades/ci-sources/java-domain-proof"); fi; python3 -B lib/benchmark/organic-java/upstream.py 367 --cases lib/benchmark/java-domain-proof/cases.json "${repos[@]}" --maven-cache "${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/in-the-loop/external-upgrades/maven" --output examples/367-avro-union-array-default/records/module-build
